dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (WHO-HAEM5 / ICC DLBCL NOS)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell (ABC-like) phenotype by the Hans algorithm: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III-B; Lugano 2014 stage IIIB with bulky disease (X) and no E lesion.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: Nodal disease is both above and below the diaphragm: ... I score this as splenic (nodal, S) involvement rather than extranodal disease, so he is not stage IV.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: a left para-aortic/aortocaval retroperitoneal mass 11.0 x 8.1 cm (bulky, at least 10 cm; 10.8 cm on outside CT 2026-08-18)... B symptoms are present: unexplained fevers to 38.1-38.3 C and drenching night sweats.

mn_stage_iv.quote: I score this as splenic (nodal, S) involvement rather than extranodal disease, so he is not stage IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: CNS-IPI is 3: age over 60 (1), stage III-IV (1), LDH above ULN (1). ... there is no more than one extranodal site, so those points are zero.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC in 50 percent of tumor cells (threshold 40 percent) and BCL2 in 80 percent (threshold 50 percent). Break-apart FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so he is not double-hit or triple-hit

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Break-apart FISH on 200 nuclei shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so he is not double-hit or triple-hit and DA-EPOCH-R is not indicated on present data.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor by IHC: MYC in 50 percent of tumor cells (threshold 40 percent) and BCL2 in 80 percent (threshold 50 percent).

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age over 60, LDH above ULN, stage III), which is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI is 3: age over 60 (1), stage III-IV (1), LDH above ULN (1). ECOG is 0-1, there is no kidney or adrenal involvement, and there is no more than one extranodal site

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP every 21 days for 6 cycles, with primary G-CSF prophylaxis from cycle 1.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: IPI 3 with bulky disease and high LDH is the population that benefited in POLARIX; he is fit

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 at the retroperitoneal bulk would prompt consolidation involved-site radiation to the bulky site (about 30 Gy, dose per radiation oncology)

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not R-CHOP-14, not DA-EPOCH-R (no double-hit), and no upfront autologous transplant (reserved for relapse).

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I do not plan a dose reduction at the start; I will reassess before cycle 2 on counts, infections and neuropathy.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: the pattern is resolved infection (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc positive, anti-HBs positive), and anti-CD20 therapy carries a high reactivation risk. Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now (no renal adjustment at eGFR 96) and continue at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Send quantitative HBV DNA and ALT now and monitor every 1 to 3 months on therapy.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now (no renal adjustment at eGFR 96) and continue at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: That is the intermediate band (2-3), not high (4-6).

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no CNS prophylaxis and no routine baseline brain MRI or lumbar puncture.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3 to 6 weeks after cycle 6 is the decision point. Deauville 1-3 is complete metabolic response and needs no radiation.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 at the retroperitoneal bulk would prompt consolidation involved-site radiation to the bulky site (about 30 Gy, dose per radiation oncology), or biopsy if the residual is small and the result would change management.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 2 days before cycle 1, with oral hydration. Check uric acid, potassium, phosphate and creatinine daily for the first 3 days of cycle 1.

sup_gcsf.quote: Pola-R-CHP every 21 days for 6 cycles, with primary G-CSF prophylaxis from cycle 1.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 58 percent with GLS -20 percent, no lung disease, no diabetes.

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-intensity pola-R-CHP: age 62, ECOG 1 (independent in all activities, working reduced hours from home, no longer hiking), Charlson comorbidity index 0

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA (baseline) for an anti-HBc positive patient before anti-CD20 therapy; not in the record.
